defaultHarness.title: Default Agent Harness
defaultHarness.description: Choose how regular new sessions select a Harness. Assistant, ACP, and explicitly requested modes are unaffected.
defaultHarness.followLastDescription: New sessions use the Harness most recently selected in ChatInput. Currently remembered: {{name}}.
defaultHarness.followLastEmptyDescription: No Harness selection is remembered yet. New sessions use {{name}} until you choose one in ChatInput.
defaultHarness.fixedDescription: New sessions always use the selected Harness; existing sessions are unchanged.
defaultHarness.fixedModeDescription: Used only for regular new sessions without an explicitly requested mode.
defaultHarness.loadFailed: Default Harness settings could not be read. This setting is locked to avoid overwriting the existing configuration.

pet.title: Desktop pet
pet.subtitle: Control whether the OpenBitFun desktop pet appears and which character it uses.
pet.petDescription: Choose a preset, or import a Petdex zip downloaded from petdex.dev.
pet.importHint: Download an appearance zip from https://petdex.dev/, then import it here.
pet.loadFailed: This pet could not be loaded. Check its package and sprite version in Pet settings.
pet.deleteConfirmBody: Delete this imported pet from your device? This cannot be undone.

workspaceSearch.title: Accelerated workspace search
workspaceSearch.subtitle: Speed up file search in large workspaces. Standard search remains available when this is off.

toolExecution.sectionDescription: Set timeouts for tool execution and user questions.

permissionPolicy.sectionDescription: Choose when OpenBitFun asks you to confirm tool actions.
permissionPolicy.askDescription: Confirm before files change, commands run, or external services are accessed.
permissionPolicy.fullAccessDescription: Do not confirm each tool action.
permissionPolicy.fullAccessWarningMessage: Full access allows tools by default without asking each time.
permissionPolicy.autoApproveDescription: Automatically allow actions that would normally need confirmation.
permissionPolicy.showInChatInputDescription: Show the permission mode below the chat input so it can be changed for the current session.
permissionPolicy.globalRulesDescription: Set shared allow, ask, or deny rules for every workspace.
permissionPolicy.globalRulesDialogDescription: These user-level rules apply to every workspace. Later project and Agent rules can override them; enforced product restrictions remain authoritative.
permissionPolicy.globalRulesEmpty: No custom global rules configured. The selected permission mode remains active.
permissionPolicy.modeDescription: Used for new sessions and can be changed temporarily from the chat input.

projectPermissions.description: Always allow decisions are saved as remembered grants for the current project; static project rules apply before a tool runs.
projectPermissions.grantsEmpty: No remembered grants for the current project.
projectPermissions.removeGrantMessage: Remove the remembered {{action}} grant for {{resource}}? The next matching request will ask again.
projectPermissions.clearGrantsMessage: Remove every remembered permission grant for the current project? The next matching requests will ask again.
projectPermissions.rulesLoadFailed: Failed to load static project rules
projectPermissions.rulesSaveFailed: Failed to save static project rules
projectPermissions.rulesConflict: The rules file changed outside OpenBitFun. Reopen project permissions before saving.

deferredToolLoading.sectionDescription: Load tool details only when they are needed.
deferredToolLoading.warning: Turning this off loads every tool definition and may increase model usage.

computerUse.sectionDescription: Allow OpenBitFun to view the screen and use the mouse and keyboard.
computerUse.enableDesc: When off, OpenBitFun cannot control desktop apps. Browser access is managed separately.
computerUse.accessibilityDesc: Allows OpenBitFun to identify and interact with controls in other apps.
computerUse.screenCaptureDesc: Allows OpenBitFun to see the contents of your screen.
computerUse.statusLoadFailed: Desktop control status could not be read. Related settings are locked until you refresh.
computerUse.desktopOnly: Desktop control is only available in the OpenBitFun desktop app.
computerUse.peerUnsupported: Desktop control runs on the connected peer host. This peer host (CLI) does not support it, so it cannot be configured here.

platformNotes.macos: This build still needs Accessibility permission in System Settings.
platformNotes.windows: Some protected windows or remote desktop environments may not be controllable.
platformNotes.linux: This desktop environment may not support full mouse, keyboard, or screen control.
platformNotes.generic: Full desktop control is not available on this system.

browserControl.sectionDescription: Choose the browser OpenBitFun uses and how it connects.
browserControl.desktopOnly: Browser control is only available in the OpenBitFun desktop app.
browserControl.peerUnsupported: Browser control runs on the connected peer host. This peer host (CLI) does not support it, so it cannot be configured here.
browserControl.preferredBrowserDesc: The default option follows your system browser.
browserControl.statusLoadFailed: Browser control status could not be read. Related settings are locked until you refresh.
browserControl.defaultCdpDesc: Use an open Chrome or Edge window and keep its tabs and signed-in accounts. The browser still confirms each connection.
browserControl.autoConnectOnStartupDesc: Connect to an open browser when OpenBitFun starts. The browser may ask again after it restarts.
browserControl.defaultCdpEnablePrompt: Trying to open {{browser}}'s Remote debugging page. Tick “Allow remote debugging for this browser instance”. If the page does not open, enter {{url}} in the browser address bar. OpenBitFun will detect the setting and continue automatically; then choose “Allow” in the browser prompt.
browserControl.defaultCdpConnectPrompt: Connecting to your current {{browser}}. Choose “Allow” in the browser prompt. If no request appears, enter {{url}} in the browser address bar and check the Remote debugging setting.
browserControl.disconnectSuccess: Disconnected from {{browser}}. Browser tabs remain open and the Remote debugging setting is unchanged.
browserControl.disconnectFailed: Could not disconnect from the browser
browserControl.userProfileSetupRequired: {{browser}}'s Remote debugging setting was not detected before the wait ended. Enter {{url}} in the browser address bar, tick “Allow remote debugging for this browser instance”, then click Enable and connect again; your current tabs and login state are preserved.
browserControl.userProfileSetupManual: Open {{url}} in {{browser}} and tick “Allow remote debugging for this browser instance”, then click Enable and connect again; your current tabs and login state are preserved.
browserControl.userProfileConnectionFailed: {{browser}} did not approve the connection, or the request timed out. Make sure the browser is running and Remote debugging is enabled, then connect again and choose Allow in the browser.
browserControl.restartFailed: Could not restart and connect to {{browser}}

restartModal.title: Restart browser
restartModal.description: OpenBitFun needs to restart the current {{browser}} before it can connect.
restartModal.warning: This will close the current browser windows.
